description: Read-only vault search: rank past memory notes by similarity to a new visual goal so the agent can reuse prior recipes, params, and prompts instead of rebuilding from scratch. Scores by query-token overlap with title/intent/prompt/tags/body, with optional tag and op boosts. Returns ranked hits with vault paths, score, matched terms, and an optional body snippet. Offline; requires TDMCP_VAULT_PATH.

include_body_snippet.description: When true, return a ~240-char body excerpt around the best-matching line.

limit.description: Maximum number of hits to return after sorting.

min_score.description: Drop hits whose normalised score is below this threshold.

ops.description: Optional operator types you expect to use (e.g. audioAnalysisCHOP). Boosts notes whose 'ops' overlap.

query.description: Free-text goal/prompt to compare past memory notes against.

tags.description: Optional tags that should boost matching notes (additive). Lowercased before match.

name: recall_similar_work

op_overlap.description: Ops in common with the query's ops.

query_terms.description: Query tokens that hit any searched field.

tag_overlap.description: Tags in common with the query's tags.

ops.description: Operator types listed on the note.

path.description: Vault-relative path of the memory note.

preview.description: Preview image path inside the vault.

prompt.description: Original artist prompt that produced this note.

recipe.description: Recipe path referenced by the note.

title.description: Frontmatter title, or the filename stem when absent.

vault_path.description: Absolute path of the configured vault root.

warnings.description: Per-note read problems; search continues on error.

title: Recall similar past work
